description: Take over a request another assistant opened, using the single-use handoff code the customer issued from their customer link. Use it only when the customer gave you a code; to start a new job use open_request. The code is used up by a successful claim and expires after 15 minutes. Your access is the scope the customer chose: read, read_cancel or book. Returns request_id and your grant; a bad, used or expired code is refused. Call get_request next. Requires direct:tasks.

code.description: The handoff code the customer gave you, exactly as issued.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by open_request or shared by the assistant that opened it.

name: claim_request
title: Claim a handoff
